---
title: "Mocap_trial"
format: html
---

```{r}
remotes::install_github("steenharsted/mocapr")
library(mocapr)
library(tidyverse)

alexia <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Alexia.csv")
View(alexia)
alexia <- alexia |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(alexia$frame)
View(alexia)


bahar <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Bahar.csv")
bahar <- bahar |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(bahar$frame)
View(bahar)

kevin <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Kevin.csv")
kevin <- kevin |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(kevin$frame)
View(kevin)

simon <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Simon.csv")
simon<- simon |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(simon$frame)
View(simon)

all_skel <- bind_rows(alexia, bahar, kevin, simon)
nrow(all_skel)            
count(all_skel, skeleton) 
View(all_skel)
alexia <- alexia |> mutate(skeleton = "Alexia")
bahar  <- bahar  |> mutate(skeleton = "Bahar")
kevin  <- kevin  |> mutate(skeleton = "Kevin")
simon  <- simon  |> mutate(skeleton = "Simon")
View(all_skel)
ggplot(all_skel, aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ, colour = skeleton)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal()
ggplot(all_skel, aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton)
ggplot(all_skel, aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ, colour = time_seconds)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c()
all_skel |>
  filter(time_seconds < 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ, colour = time_seconds)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c()
names(all_skel)
pair_KB <- inner_join(
  kevin |> select(frame, time_seconds, leader_x = CGX, leader_z = CGZ),
  bahar |> select(frame, follower_x = CGX, follower_z = CGZ),
  by = "frame"
)
pair_KB <- pair_KB |>
  mutate(distance_m = sqrt((leader_x - follower_x)^2 +
                           (leader_z - follower_z)^2) / 1000)
  ggplot(pair_KB, aes(time_seconds, distance_m)) +
  geom_line()  
                    
```
